# MIA EVENTS

> Corporate event planning and management across Cyprus, from concept to execution. The website is available in English and Greek.

MIA EVENTS plans corporate events, conferences, business meetings, team experiences and festive celebrations. Services also include venue and supplier coordination, event design and production, on-site management, and corporate gifting.

## Website

- [MIA EVENTS homepage](https://www.miaevents.company/): Company overview and event planning services.
- [About MIA EVENTS](https://www.miaevents.company/#about): Maria's experience and approach.
- [Our Work](https://www.miaevents.company/#work): Photo albums featuring galas, summer events, team activities, and festive celebrations.
- [Services](https://www.miaevents.company/#services): Events and experiences, planning and production, and corporate gifting.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.miaevents.company/#faq): Planning, locations, budgets and logistics.
- [Contact](https://www.miaevents.company/#contact): Contact options and the WhatsApp enquiry form.
